responsibility: Declares the ResolvePathRef visitor used to lower Rust path expressions and qualified path expressions into GCC trees. Its API exposes path-specific resolution plus a lower-level resolve helper keyed by final path segment, node mappings, and qualified-path state, distinguishing it from the broader expression compiler that calls into it.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ResolvePathRef resolver class and its path-specific Compile/resolve entry points. Unlike rust-compile-resolve-path.cc, it exposes the interface for lowering path and qualified-path expressions without containing the lookup and on-demand compilation logic.
